learning_objective: 🎯 We will explore the beautiful world of nature and learn to draw trees, leaves, and colourful flowers!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Plants are not just one color! When we look outside, we can see dark green, light green, yellow, and even brown on the branches.
Every leaf has a different shape. Some are round, some are pointy, and some look like little stars! We can draw them by making a simple line for the stem first.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Magic Leaf Rubbing
fun_activity.instructions: Collect a fallen leaf from a garden. Put it under a blank paper and gently rub a green crayon over it to see the magic pattern appear!

quick_recap: ⭐ Nature gives us so many wonderful shapes and colors to draw.
⭐ Leaves and flowers come in all different sizes.
⭐ We can mix colors to make our trees look real and beautiful!
